templates.title: Start from one of these
templates.hint: Each is a runbook you can change before saving.
templates.standup_prompt: Summarise what changed on this project since yesterday: tasks moved, reviews opened, runs that failed. Post it as one short update.
templates.triage_prompt: Look at every task with no assignee and no priority. Give each one a priority, a label and a first comment saying what it will take.
templates.sweep_prompt: Find tasks that have not moved in two weeks. On each, say what is blocking it and either propose a next step or propose closing it.
templates.digest_prompt: Write the week in one page: what shipped, what slipped, what failed and what needs a decision.
templates.release_prompt: Read what merged since the last release and draft the notes: what changed, who it affects, and anything that needs care on upgrade.
templates.watch_prompt: Look at the runs that failed since the last firing. Group them by cause and open one task for any cause that appears more than twice.
